limitations.limitation: Squared-error fitting is sensitive to training-response contamination.
limitations.evidence: baseline_paper.md specifies 12% training response contamination; model.py fits all responses with unweighted np.linalg.lstsq and no robust loss or outlier handling.
limitations.status: Mechanism supported by implementation; prediction degradation has not been measured in this role.

limitations.limitation: The predictor is restricted to an affine function of the supplied features.
limitations.evidence: model.py adds an intercept and fits linear coefficients without nonlinear features or interactions.
limitations.status: Verified structural restriction; the specified synthetic linear task does not establish that this restriction causes error.

limitations.limitation: The baseline provides no explicit adaptation to the stated validation/test covariate scale shift.
limitations.evidence: baseline_paper.md specifies a clean covariate scale shift; model.py applies the training coefficients directly to test features.
limitations.status: Verified absence of adaptation; scale shift alone does not establish failure under a correctly specified linear conditional model.

limitations.limitation: The implementation has no explicit regularization or conditioning diagnostics.
limitations.evidence: model.py uses np.linalg.lstsq with rcond=None and does not expose penalties or report rank and singular values.
limitations.status: Verified implementation property; instability or rank deficiency in the actual inputs has not been established.

limitations.limitation: The interface returns only point predictions and ignores configuration.
limitations.evidence: fit_predict returns b @ fitted_coefficients; config is unused, and no uncertainty estimates or fitting diagnostics are returned.
limitations.status: Verified interface limitation; whether additional outputs are required is unspecified.

limitations.limitation: The documented scope supports a demonstration rather than a novelty or broad generalization claim.
limitations.evidence: baseline_paper.md describes synthetic linear regression with four features and explicitly identifies the exercise as known robust regression rather than a novel algorithm.
limitations.status: Documented scope; these files provide no empirical results establishing generalization beyond that setting.
